checks: Same-size files with different complete hashes are rejected by the real worker and UI
Full-content verification and explicit review move the location while retaining the original ID in one durable transaction
Reload preserves original ratings, manual tags and favorites; the moved file plays from its granted directory
Explicit Undo restores both previous metadata mappings without erasing subsequent saved marks
Quota failures roll back removal, restore, file move and Undo atomically
Stale review, mismatched contents and already-owned destinations are rejected
Delayed catalog journal cannot revive an old mapping or deliberately removed alias
Reload and Undo preserve the canonical ID and byte-identical personal records
Unsupported future identity records remain intact
